source: Choose an environment (desert, sea or tundra), changed when you gain a barbarian level. When you enter your rage its 10-foot aura wakes, and on each later turn of the rage a bonus action wakes it again. Desert: each other creature in it takes 2 fire damage (3 at 5th level, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th, 6 at 20th). Sea: one creature of your choice in it makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 lightning damage, half on a success (2d6 at 10th, 3d6 at 15th, 4d6 at 20th). Tundra: each creature of your choice in it gains 2 temporary hit points (rising with the desert's numbers). Its save DC is 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.
Storm Soul

A lasting boon of your environment. Desert: you resist fire damage, shrug off extreme heat, and can set an unattended flammable object alight with a touch as an action. Sea: you resist lightning damage, breathe underwater and gain a 30-foot swimming speed. Tundra: you resist cold damage, shrug off extreme cold, and can freeze a 5-foot cube of water with a touch as an action.
Shielding Storm
Every ally inside your Storm Aura shares your Storm Soul damage resistance.
Raging Storm

Your aura's environment sharpens. Desert: right after a creature in the aura hits you, a reaction makes it save on Dexterity or take fire damage equal to half your barbarian level. Sea: when you hit a creature in the aura, a reaction makes it save on Strength or be knocked prone. Tundra: whenever the aura's effect activates, one creature you can see in it saves on Strength or has its speed reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.
Path of the Zealot
A divine champion whose fury is holy, and who death itself has trouble keeping.
Divine Fury
The first creature you hit each turn while raging takes an extra 1d6 + half your barbarian level radiant or necrotic damage.
Warrior of the Gods
A spell that restores you to life needs no material component.
Fanatical Focus
Once per rage, reroll a failed saving throw and use the new result.
Zealous Presence
A bonus action, once per long rest, grants up to ten allies within 60 feet advantage on attacks and saves until your next turn.
Rage Beyond Death

While you rage, having 0 hit points doesn't knock you unconscious. You still make death saving throws and suffer the usual effects of taking damage at 0 hit points, but if you would die from failed death saves you don't die until your rage ends, and then only if you still have 0 hit points.
Path of the Beast
Rage grows weapons out of the barbarian's own body: claws, a tail, savage teeth.
Form of the Beast

When you enter your rage, grow one natural weapon until it ends, a melee weapon that uses Strength: Bite (1d8 piercing; once on each of your turns, a bite that hits while you have less than half your hit points restores hit points equal to your proficiency bonus), Claws (1d6 slashing, one in each hand; once on each of your turns, attacking with a claw in the Attack action lets you make one more claw attack) or Tail (1d8 piercing with a 10-foot reach; when a creature you can see within 10 feet hits you, a reaction adds 1d8 to your AC against that attack).
Bestial Soul
Your natural weapons count as magical, and you can adapt to swim, climb or jump after each rest.
Infectious Fury
A proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest, a natural-weapon hit forces a Wisdom save: the target either attacks a creature of your choice or takes 2d12 psychic damage.
Call the Hunt

When you enter your rage, a proficiency-bonus number of times per long rest, you can choose a number of other willing creatures you can see within 30 feet equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum one). You gain 5 temporary hit points for each that accepts, and until the rage ends each of them can, once on each of its turns, roll a d6 and add it to the damage of an attack that hits.
Path of Wild Magic
Raw magic leaks out of this barbarian every time their temper does.
Magic Awareness
As an action, sense spells and magic items within 60 feet, a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus.
Wild Surge

When you enter your rage, roll a d8 for a magical effect that lasts the rage (save DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier): 1, shadowy tendrils deal 1d12 necrotic damage to each creature of your choice within 30 feet that fails a Constitution save and give you 1d12 temporary hit points; 2, you teleport up to 30 feet, and again as a bonus action on later turns; 3, a spirit appears beside a creature within 30 feet and bursts at the end of the turn, dealing 1d6 force damage to each creature within 5 feet of it that fails a Dexterity save, and again as a bonus action on later turns; 4, a weapon you hold deals force damage and gains light and thrown (20/60), returning to your hand; 5, each creature that hits you with an attack roll takes 1d6 force damage; 6, you and your allies within 10 feet of you gain +1 AC; 7, the ground within 15 feet of you is difficult terrain for your enemies; 8, a bolt of light deals 1d6 radiant damage to a creature within 30 feet and blinds it until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Constitution save, and again as a bonus action on later turns.
Bolstering Magic
